import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Check agent directory
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria/agent/")
print("Agent dir:", stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
EOF
